notes.title: Uh Oh Airlines Demo Patch Notes 0.0.22
notes.notes: [p]✈️ **General**[/p][p]- bathroom door is now forced open on fire and overflow[/p][p]- reworked customization screen so it should more reliably save your character[/p][p]- cart maintenance day now working as intended[/p][p]- added audio cue to scared request[/p][p]- empty inserts are back[/p][p]- added "disable motion sickness" toggle to stop summer seats from swaying and fighter pilot flight camera from changing[/p][p]🌎 **Localization**[/p][p]- updated some Indonesian localizations[/p][p]**🛜Networking**[/p][p]- beach ball now replicated[/p][p]- fixed a bug where highlights didnt work on the client after you picked stuff up[/p][p]- fixed a bug where the flight deck door was missing[/p][p]- fixed a bug where player 1 customization wasnt initializing on client[/p][p]- fixed a bug where fire wasnt visible on client[/p][p]👀**Visual**[/p][p]- main menu badge text should no longer fall off the edges[/p][p]- most buttons should no longer clip long text and should scale instead[/p][p]- loading screen plane now respects pause[/p][p]- options menu long words should no longer cut off[/p][p]⚖️ **Balance**[/p][p]- increased scared chance by 100%[/p][p]- increased heatwave chance[/p][p]🐛**Bug Fixes**[/p][p]- fixed a bug where special days weren't updating properly on calendar open[/p][p]- fixed a bug in customization screen where the default selections weren't always what the character actually looked like[/p][p]- fixed a bug where dog show wasnt giving enough dog requests when game was played in another language[/p][p]- fixed a bug where passengers could fall asleep while standing[/p][p]- fixed a bug where passengers that are hit by the cart while in the bathroom queue would break the bathroom line for everyone else when they left to go back to their seat after medical attention[/p][p]- fixed a tutorial bug where passengers could lose their request when dashed into and break the tutorial[/p][p]- fixed a bug where you could throw the dog away in the bathroom[/p][p]- fixed a bug where stuff once placed on the cart could be interacted with from anywhere[/p][p]- fixed a main menu navigation bug where backing out of menus sometimes didnt correctly set the focus[/p][p]- fixed a bug where main menu could lose focus after removing a second player from the game[/p]

notes.title: Uh Oh Airlines Demo Patch Notes 0.0.21.1
notes.notes: [p]✈️ **General**[/p][p]- can now place items in inserts that have been emptied[/p][p]- beach balls no longer affect navigation[/p][p]- pax in pool are no longer affected by turbulence[/p][p]- trash should no longer spawn in pool[/p][p]- air freshener can now clean seats[/p][p]🌎 **Localization**[/p][p]- added indonesian localization[/p][p]- added malay localization[/p][p][/p][p]⚖️ **Balance**[/p][p]- reduced points necessary to pass level 6 by 50 points for each medal[/p][p]- reduced poolside neediness[/p][p]- reduced max simultaneous requests for summer from 4>3[/p][p]**Optimizations**[/p][p]🐛**Bug Fixes**[/p][p]- fixed a bug where player 1 A button stopped working at the start of some new levels in local co-op[/p][p]- fixed a bug where all seasons except for spring weren't finding the correct special days[/p][p]- fixed a bug where unresolved medical emergencies didnt count as violations[/p][p]- fixed a bug where shove could stop working after a successful one[/p][p]- fixed a bug where inserts were not interactable immediately after being put in the cart[/p][p]- fixed a bug where trying to remove an insert from the cart that had something manually placed would cause everything in that insert to disappear[/p][p]- fixed a bug where spread barf was spawning in mid air[/p][p]- fixed a bug where you could get stuck in the bathroom holding stuff you couldnt throw away[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Uh Oh Airlines Demo Patch Notes 0.0.21
notes.notes: [p]✈️ **General**[/p][p]- calendar is now built dynamically upon calendar creation instead of save game creation[/p][p]- passengers now verbally greet instead of ding[/p][p]- counter now plays a negative sound when you cannot place it down while standing on top of the cabinet placement spot[/p][p]- added steamdeck resolution (1280x800) to resolution selector[/p][p]- increased size of front galley so there is slightly more space to move around with the cart up front[/p][p]- dirty seat request now triggers call sound[/p][p]- dashing into passengers now stops them from opening the boarding door and stops arguments[/p][p]- added beach ball to summer days[/p][p]- can now throw away items into garbage bag placed on cart or counter[/p][p]🌎 **Localization**[/p][p]**🛜Networking**[/p][p]👀**Visual**[/p][p]- top of cart now lights up instead of side when looking at it[/p][p]- added vsync toggle[/p][p]- [/p][p]⚖️ **Balance**[/p][p]- increased fire chance on Pyrotechnics Festival day by 100x[/p][p]- reduced reach distance by 20%[/p][p]- slightly increased starting cone trace size - this should help with interactions hitting what you want more often[/p][p]**Optimizations**[/p][p]🐛**Bug Fixes**[/p][p]- fixed a bug where dead passengers could get up after turbulence[/p][p]- fixed a bug where multiple passenger request success sounds could play at once and they'd be very loud[/p][p]- fixed a bug where some resolutions would fail to be set properly[/p][p]- fixed a bug where heatwave wasnt working properly[/p][p]- fixed a bug where passengers that died while opening the boarding door would not stop the opening door siren[/p][p]- fixed a bug where screenshake toggle needed to be clicked twice to turn off[/p][p]- fixed a bug where select day button didnt work in summer and later levels[/p][p]- fixed a bug where some music wasnt affected by music slider[/p][p]- fixed a bug where sometimes the character customization wouldnt stick[/p][p]- fixed a bug where tutorial popup language was incorrect[/p][p]- fixed a bug where customization screen would show blank character instead of default character[/p]

notes.title: Uh Oh Airlines Demo 0.0.20.0.1 Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]- fixed a bug where night music wasnt playing[/p][p]- added new service song[/p][p]- fixed a bug where sometimes the cart wasnt able to move[/p][p]- fixed a bug where disable zoom toggle didnt work sometimes[/p]

notes.title: Uh Oh Airlines Demo 0.0.18.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]✈️ **General**[/p][p]- can no longer navigate to the next and previous season buttons in calendar with controller. they must now be pressed with the buttons[/p][p]- updated main menu[/p][p]- slightly simplified ice water tutorial so its not as many steps[/p][p]- day 2 tutorial is now less restrictive on which objects you pickup/place where. should still progress you through the tutorial in many more situations[/p][p]- better ragdoll [/p][p]- ragdoll recovery should overall be closer to the mesh location [/p][p]- enabled z constraint on all humans. this should keep all notes.title: Uh Oh Airlines Demo 0.0.16 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]✈️ **General**[/p][p]- inputs changed to be more similar to games in its genre[/p][p]	- X - open down/shove[/p][p]	- A - pickup/putdown[/p][p]	- B - Dash[/p][p]- shove is now remappable[/p][p]- added accessibility option to lock the camera Y position so it does not move up and down when the character does[/p][p]- options menu now has sections so its easier to read[/p][p]- FA's now fall if standing during landing[/p][p]- added a little more space between front cabinets and the cockpit[/p][p]- added dx11 launch option[/p][p]- increased time between cart fill reminders on day 2[/p][p]👀**Visual**[/p][p]- disabled the devil that is motion blur[/p][p]⚖️ **Balance**[/p][p]- increased threshold for bumping into passengers causing them to need a medkit - this should make it so that when walking, they fall over less[/p][p]- day 1 now requires only 30 points for gold[/p][p]- pilot should no longer request coffee on day 8[/p][p]🐛**Bug Fixes**[/p][p]- fixed a bug where mapping the interact button to another button didnt move the passenger interact as well[/p][p]- fixed a bug where accept button only worked once on controller remapper[/p][p]- fixed a bug in the co-op customization menu where both players could control both customization menus[/p][p]- fixed a bug where only player 1 would fall down during takeoff[/p][p]- fixed a bug in day 1 tutorial where tutorial would softlock if you missed the water request[/p][p]- fixed a bug where bathroom overflow sound wasnt looping[/p][p]- fixed a bug where cookies and pretzels weren't burning when cooked and were just disappearing[/p][p]- fixed a bug in the customization menu where you could still select the shirt if you spawned with the jacket[/p]

notes.notes: [p]❗**Visual**[/p][p]- orange juice is now more orange instead of yellow[/p][p]⚖️ **Balance**[/p][p]- disabled violation points deduction on day 1 and 2[/p][p]🐛**Bug Fixes**[/p][p]- fixed a bug where pretzels couldnt be picked up after it fell out of cart[/p][p]- fixed a bug where you could start boarding on day 2 early by interacting with the boarding door despite there being no progress bar[/p][p]- fixed a bug where passengers listening to music that get hit by luggage would make an unfixable music request for everyone around them[/p][p]- fixed a bug where greeting pax with a request during boarding caused an unnecessary sound[/p][p]- fixed a bug where you could put coffee pot and water pot in insert[/p][p]- fixed a bug where the calendar would show that you got more gold medals than you did when progressing past off days[/p][p]- humans will now try even harder to find a good spot to stand up[/p]
